body:
SUPPORT-SLICE PREFLIGHT CORRECTION — one existing court is presently inert.

I incorporated M1's handoff and rechecked the source. The dead `CostBreakdown.unreachable` arm must not be presented as a runtime GraphHsmm court: current `externals` and `unranked` populations are both `AlignState.External`, so that fallback cannot execute. The new carrier may still cover `unreachable` through direct construction and wire round-trip, as the bead already records.

More importantly, `fixtures/src/test/resources/golden/hsmm-v3-wog.json` is not referenced by any Scala test, and `WarOfTheGhostsCodecGolden.ExpectedChecksum` is defined but never asserted. The current suite computes fresh bytes and round-trips those same bytes; it does not compare against the committed resource. Therefore changing the wire does not currently make the alleged golden fail. The implementation acceptance must add a real byte/checksum comparison against a committed `hsmm-v4-wog.json`, retain v3 as an explicit unsupported-schema/refusal fixture, and include a mutation that restores external numeric support or stops reading the resource. That is the executable form of M1's 10-of-18 falsification test.

One vocabulary point remains for the chief's explicit ruling: the routed three-state proposal names `Unestablished(EmptyEligibility | ZeroEligibleWeight)`, while M1 notes the existing `UndefinedReason.ZeroTotalWeight`. I will not choose between a dedicated support reason and reuse of a reduction reason until the public ADT decision says which semantic boundary is intended. No source edit or reservation has been made.
